message.content:
**Uno – Quick Overview** | What | How it works | |------|--------------| | **Goal** | Be the first player to score 500 points (or whatever you agree on). Points are earned by being the first to finish each round and by collecting cards from opponents. | | **Setup** | • Deal 7 cards to each player.
• Place the remaining deck face‑down as the draw pile.
• Flip the top card of the draw pile to start the discard pile. | | **Turn order** | Players take turns clockwise (unless a direction‑changing card is played). | | **Playing a card** | On your turn you may play one card that matches either the **color** or the **number/symbol** of the top card on the discard pile. | | **Special cards** | • **Skip** – next player loses their turn.
• **Reverse** – changes play direction.
• **Draw Two** – next player draws two cards and skips their turn.
• **Wild** – you choose the new color.
• **Wild Draw Four** – you choose the new color; next player draws four cards and skips their turn (must be played only if you have no matching color). | | **Drawing** | If you cannot play a card, you must draw one from the draw pile. If that card can be played, you may play it immediately; otherwise, your turn ends. | | **Uno** | When you have only one card left, shout “UNO!” before your opponent takes their turn. If you forget and another player catches you, you must draw two penalty cards. | | **Winning a round** | The round ends when a player discards all of their cards. That player scores points equal to the sum of the values of the cards still held by the other players. | | **Scoring** | • Number cards = face value.
• Skip/Reverse/Draw Two = 20 points.
• Wild/Wild Draw Four = 50 points. | | **Game end** | First player to reach the agreed‑upon point total wins the game. | **Optional house rules** Feel free to tweak the rules—e.g., allow “draw two” to stack, change the starting hand size, or add custom cards. The key is to keep the game fast, colorful, and fun!
